subject: Plotting rectangles with beginning and ending times

messages.author: dab9a7816b9c9983
messages.subject: Plotting rectangles with beginning and ending times
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to imitate the example from page 86 of Hadley's ggplot2
book to plot rectangles. The goal is to visualize series of activities
with beginning and ending times: (sorry that they have to be pasted on
an text editor to align well)

> gt1
activity begTime endTime
1 Null 1.307738e+12 1.307738e+12
2 WorkingBeforeComputer 1.307738e+12 1.307739e+12
3 Cooking 1.307739e+12 1.307739e+12
4 WorkingBeforeComputer 1.307739e+12 1.307740e+12
5 Lunch 1.307740e+12 1.307741e+12
6 Walking 1.307741e+12 1.307743e+12
7 Null 1.307743e+12 1.307743e+12
8 Walking 1.307743e+12 1.307744e+12
9 WorkingBeforeComputer 1.307744e+12 1.307750e+12
10 Walking 1.307750e+12 1.307752e+12
11 WorkingBeforeComputer 1.307752e+12 1.307759e+12
12 Cooking 1.307759e+12 1.307760e+12
13 Gaming 1.307760e+12 1.307763e+12
14 Cooking 1.307763e+12 1.307764e+12
15 Dinner 1.307764e+12 1.307765e+12
16 Gaming 1.307765e+12 1.307768e+12
17 Null 1.307768e+12 1.307768e+12
>
> background = ggplot(gt1);
>
> gt1_plot = geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, ymin = begTime, ymax = endTime, fill = activity), xmin = 0, xmax = 90, data = gt1)
> background + gt1_plot

But after the last command, R prompts me an error message "not for non-
functions" (translated from Traditional Chinese, it was something
meaning the same in English in my office computer).

Any help is highly appreciated.

Pumbaa

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: Re: Plotting rectangles with beginning and ending times
parts:
This works for me:

gt1$xmin <- 0
gt1$xmax <- 90

ggplot(gt1) +
geom_rect(aes(NULL,NULL,xmin=xmin,xmax=xmax,ymin=begTime,ymax=endTime,fill=activity))

but there should be a way to do it without creating xmin/xmax
variables in the data frame.
